name: I Turned My BFF's Dogs Human!
source:
When her bestie Kai asks her to dog-sit for him, Kiki jumps at the opportunity hoping that just talking through her feelings with anyone--even dogs--will help heal her heartache and give her clarity. But as the days drone on and dreams of her ex-lover plague her, Kiki grows frustrated with her inability to meaningfully communicate with the dogs. 

She resorts to using magic to make talking with them easier. But her spell backfires turning the dogs human instead of making them speak human. 

Can she turn them back before Kai returns, and can she still get the healing and clarity she wants?

[From [url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/itmbdh]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当她的好朋友凯请她照顾他的狗时，琪琪抓住了这个机会，希望只要与任何人——甚至是狗——倾诉自己的感受，就能帮助治愈她的心痛，让她头脑清醒。但随着日子一天天过去，她对前情人的梦不断困扰着她，琪琪因无法与狗进行有意义的交流而感到沮丧。

她求助于使用魔法来让与他们的交谈变得更容易。但她的咒语适得其反，让狗变成了人类，而不是让它们说人类话。

她能在凯回来之前扭转这些局面吗？她还能得到她想要的治愈和清晰度吗？
